Evan: Drafting the internal release note for Wed 02:00 UTC window. Need ops to confirm runbook and who runs the pin. Short paste below.

Evan: ```
Release v2.3.1-rc (internal canary -> public)
- Fix: dispatcher memory leak under burst (reduces OOMs on high-concurrency)
- Tune: KV cache heuristics (~14% token cost improvement on chat loads)
- Ops: Canary pin with auto-fallback to v2.2.9 if p99 >200ms sustained 10m
- Impact: No API changes; SDK patch recommended
```

Rhea: Can we include explicit rollback CLI and ownership? ops wants quick copy.

Evan: Sure. Rollback CLI: `./deploy rollback --to v2.2.9 --reason "p99>200ms_10m"`
Pin command: `./deploy pin --version v2.3.1-rc --scope internal --actor @Miles`

Miles: Ops runbook (summary):
1) T0 = 2026-03-24T02:00:00Z -> run internal pin
2) Automated health checks for first 10m, monitor p50/p95/p99 + error spikes
3) If stable, wait additional 80m then run public pin and trigger public blurb
4) Trigger rollback CLI if p99>200ms for 10 continuous minutes or error rate >3x baseline

ops-oncall: Roster: @ops-oncall (primary), @Ivy (backup). I'll monitor from 01:50-04:00 UTC and open #incident if thresholds hit.

Evan: Who posts internal announce at T-30m? I can post it with the runbook and snippets. Rhea will handle public copy.

Rhea: I'll prepare both internal and external snippets. Public line: "Patch to improve service stability; no customer action required." Internal will include CLI lines and runbook.

deploy-bot: Deploybot scheduled: window=2026-03-24T02:00:00Z, duration=30m, change-id=ch_997999, canary=true, auto-fallback=v2.2.9.

Miles: I'll execute the internal pin and stay on the thread for the flip. If I run rollback I'll post the command and reason.

Evan: PR for release copy: https://github.com/redwood-inference/release-notes/pull/437. Please review by EOD.

ops-oncall: Acknowledged. Roster and monitor confirmed.

Miles: LGTM. :thumbsup:

Evan: Locking this for prep; will re-open if comments.
